title: Interpretation of words to be gender-neutral.
bodyText: With regard to the rights, benefits, protections, and responsibilities of persons set forth under this chapter, all gender-specific terminology, such as "wife", "husband", "mother", "father", "aunt", "uncle", "niece", "nephew", or similar terms, shall be construed in a gender-neutral manner. This rule of interpretation shall apply to all administrative rules adopted hereunder.
crossReferences: Interpretation of words to be gender-neutral, see §578-18.

[§580-18]  Interpretation of words to be gender-neutral.  With regard to the rights, benefits, protections, and responsibilities of persons set forth under this chapter, all gender-specific terminology, such as "wife", "husband", "mother", "father", "aunt", "uncle", "niece", "nephew", or similar terms, shall be construed in a gender-neutral manner.  This rule of interpretation shall apply to all administrative rules adopted hereunder. [L 2023, c 161, §2]
